source_role: secondary discovery/index route derived in bulk from Hawkins 2000/2024 with additions
exclusions: Does not include non-monumental seals, bullae, pottery, metalware, lead strips etc.; therefore never a total-corpus denominator.
admission_policy: Names may seed discovery/reconciliation only. Canonical object admission requires authoritative Hawkins/eDiAna/object-source reconciliation.
source_scope_statement: Public list covers monumental inscriptions and explicitly excludes seals, bullae, pottery, metalware, lead strips and other non-monumental items.

authority_reconciliation.primary_target: CHLI III alphabetical list p.671 + locations pp.674-676 + concordance p.677
authority_reconciliation.public_access_status: METADATA/SECTION_ROUTE_CONFIRMED; INDEX_CONTENT_NOT EXPOSED IN CURRENT SEARCHABLE PAGE
authority_reconciliation.fallback: Use public monumental names as discovery seeds only, then reconcile record-by-record to authoritative CHLI/eDiAna sources.

enumeration_metrics.reason: Discovery names are not promoted until authoritative object/edition reconciliation.
enumeration_metrics.note: Entries with ranges/fragments may represent multiple physical inscriptions; counts are discovery-list entries, not object denominators.
